notes: Assumptions that change the number: beef mince 15 % fat; 30 pur pastry strips at ~7 g each; of the litre of oil, ~70 g is absorbed (about a third of the pastry's weight); only half the flour sealing paste is used; 3 samoosas a serving. Sanity check: Checkers beef samoosas are 306 kcal / 100 g (FatSecret ZA) and ours are ~294 kcal / 100 g (~29 g and ~85 kcal each). Farm Boy's 70 g fried beef samosa is 220 kcal (314 kcal / 100 g).
